company: Tuya Smart (Hangzhou) — BLE configuration SDK (com.thingclips.sdk.bluetooth Android SDK; rebranded from Thingclips)
UUID_purpose: GATT Service observed in Android app com.grameenphone.alo but declared in third-party SDK package `com.thingclips.sdk.bluetooth` as Java field `SERVER_UUID`. The host APK's vendor is NOT the UUID owner; the SDK author is. Classification source: file-level-default. Phase-4 SDK identification: Tuya BLE config SDK — UUID base `7475-7961-626c-636f6e666967` decodes ASCII to `tu` `ya` `bl` `config`. Field names SERVER / WRITE / NOTIFY (uuids 00001000/1001/1002 in that namespace). The other UUID16s (1910/1912/1920) are obfuscated tokens in the same Tuya SDK, plus 7fdd = Telink mesh-test (Tuya often uses Telink chips). Observed in 6 host apps including IoT Solution AiDot, Grameenphone alo, Coclean Degrii, ElegrP home, Movinghub, Xtreme Cables..

UUID_purpose: GATT Service observed in Android app com.grameenphone.alo but declared in third-party SDK package `com.thingclips.sdk.bluetooth` as Java field `dqdbbqp`. The host APK's vendor is NOT the UUID owner; the SDK author is. Classification source: file-level-default. Phase-4 SDK identification: Tuya BLE config SDK — UUID base `7475-7961-626c-636f6e666967` decodes ASCII to `tu` `ya` `bl` `config`. Field names SERVER / WRITE / NOTIFY (uuids 00001000/1001/1002 in that namespace). The other UUID16s (1910/1912/1920) are obfuscated tokens in the same Tuya SDK, plus 7fdd = Telink mesh-test (Tuya often uses Telink chips). Observed in 6 host apps including IoT Solution AiDot, Grameenphone alo, Coclean Degrii, ElegrP home, Movinghub, Xtreme Cables..

company: Tuya Smart (Hangzhou) — BLE configuration SDK (com.thingclips.sdk.bluetooth Android SDK; rebranded from Thingclips)
UUID_purpose: GATT Service observed in Android app com.grameenphone.alo but declared in third-party SDK package `com.thingclips.sdk.bluetooth` as Java field `dpdqppp`. The host APK's vendor is NOT the UUID owner; the SDK author is. Classification source: file-level-default. Phase-4 SDK identification: Tuya BLE config SDK — UUID base `7475-7961-626c-636f6e666967` decodes ASCII to `tu` `ya` `bl` `config`. Field names SERVER / WRITE / NOTIFY (uuids 00001000/1001/1002 in that namespace). The other UUID16s (1910/1912/1920) are obfuscated tokens in the same Tuya SDK, plus 7fdd = Telink mesh-test (Tuya often uses Telink chips). Observed in 6 host apps including IoT Solution AiDot, Grameenphone alo, Coclean Degrii, ElegrP home, Movinghub, Xtreme Cables..

company: Tuya Smart (Hangzhou) — BLE configuration SDK (com.thingclips.sdk.bluetooth Android SDK; rebranded from Thingclips)
UUID_purpose: GATT Service observed in Android app com.grameenphone.alo but declared in third-party SDK package `com.thingclips.sdk.bluetooth` as Java field `WRITE_UUID`. The host APK's vendor is NOT the UUID owner; the SDK author is. Classification source: file-level-default. Phase-4 SDK identification: Tuya BLE config SDK — UUID base `7475-7961-626c-636f6e666967` decodes ASCII to `tu` `ya` `bl` `config`. Field names SERVER / WRITE / NOTIFY (uuids 00001000/1001/1002 in that namespace). The other UUID16s (1910/1912/1920) are obfuscated tokens in the same Tuya SDK, plus 7fdd = Telink mesh-test (Tuya often uses Telink chips). Observed in 6 host apps including IoT Solution AiDot, Grameenphone alo, Coclean Degrii, ElegrP home, Movinghub, Xtreme Cables..
